label: B25-LOGIC-IMM-REPAIR-VOLATILE-SOF
title: Generate one content-addressed volatile SOF from the accepted T-027 fitted database
reads: docs/tasks/evidence/T-20260920-020.json and its task-local runner as the accepted assembler template only
scope: Create a never-before-used task-owned byte-identical clone of the accepted T-027 post-STA project, verify source and fitted database identities, invoke Quartus assembler exactly once, and seal the single volatile catapult_a10.sof with size, SHA-256, Quartus checksum, design hash and JTAG usercode.

acceptance.freshness: The T-030 remote root must not preexist. Copy only from the exact T-027 accepted physical root; never import T-017/T-020 or any other DB/SOF.
acceptance.source: T-027 source pre/post manifest remains identical and the T-030 clone baseline matches it byte-for-byte; QPF/QSF/SDC/boot/fit/STA identities match the input contract.
acceptance.database: The fitted database payload remains unchanged. Only an explicitly reviewed assembler metadata delta is allowed, with zero removed paths and zero changes below final/partitioned/synthesized payloads.
acceptance.assembler: Invoke exactly once: quartus_asm --read_settings_files=on --write_settings_files=off catapult_a10 -c catapult_a10. Require Successful, zero errors, zero warnings and exact command identity in stdout/report.
acceptance.artifacts: Exactly one catapult_a10.sof exists; POF/JIC/RBF/JBC/SVF/JAM counts are zero. Record and fetch SOF bytes/hash/checksum/design hash/usercode plus reports and immutable manifests.
acceptance.warning_boundary: No synthesis warning is hidden or reinterpreted. T-028 remains the source-qualified synthesis acceptance evidence; assembler neither filters nor regenerates synthesis evidence.
acceptance.boundary: No synthesis, fitter, STA, source edit, programmer, JTAG terminal, FPGA configuration, Flash/JIC/EPCQ, reset, power or unknown-process termination.

resource: Every GamePC preflight/clone/query/assembler/fetch action holds resource-lock gamepc. Require no conflicting EDA/programmer/terminal process; never stop an unknown or pre-existing process. One Quartus process only, event-driven monitoring with waits up to one hour.
forbidden_regions: tracked source, RTL, firmware, QSF, SDC, IP, policy or expected-result modification
synthesis, fitter, STA, timing optimization or reuse of another candidate database/SOF
POF/JIC/RBF/JBC/SVF/JAM and all persistent Flash/EPCQ formats
quartus_pgm, jtagconfig, nios2-terminal, FPGA configuration, board/SoC reset or power action

dispatch.monitoring: event-driven; one-hour maximum wait; no frequent polling

result.next: authorized volatile board interaction with paced ?/p/d/Z and golden rollback control
